def permute(nums):
    res = []

    def dfs(i):                        # nums[:i] is fixed
        if i == len(nums):
            res.append(nums[:])
            return
        for j in range(i, len(nums)):
            nums[i], nums[j] = nums[j], nums[i]   # choose nums[j] for slot i
            dfs(i + 1)
            nums[i], nums[j] = nums[j], nums[i]   # undo

    dfs(0)
    return res
